thread:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up for Horizon outage — I pulled the root cause notes: intermittent VPC peering flaps + on-prem NAT port exhaustion caused partial tenant isolation. Posting owners and minimal timelines.
Devon: Thanks Maya. Can you confirm I own the peering config-drift remediation?
Maya: @Devon yes — you own peering config and CI checks. Target: end of week (Fri).
Priya: I'll take the on-prem NAT/ACL cleanup and add BGP session alerts. Estimate: Tue EOD.
Sam: I'll implement a dedicated->hosted automatic fallback for requests when isolation detected. I'll start a PR today.
Ops-bot: Incident INC-8942 created and linked to postmortem.
Irene: Two asks: 1) SRE approval gating for firewall changes, 2) add a post-change smoke test to rollout checklist.
Charlie: Noted. I'll add smoke test to the deployment playbook and schedule a handoff.
Maya: Minimal runbook snippet (for quick reference):
```
# quick checks for oncall
- verify vpc peering status: aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters "Name=status,Values=active"
- check BGP sessions on-prem: ssh bastion sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
- NAT port usage: curl http://onprem-metrics:9000/metrics | grep nat_port_usage
```
Devon: Will write the config linter + CI test that detects peer route drift. Will add tests to the model-serving repo.
Priya: Added test plan to INC-8942 (see checklist), and mock traffic steps for NAT exhaustion.
Sam: PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/ops/pulls/245 — fallback detection + rollforward. Need review from @Irene for safety constraints.
Irene: I'll review the PR today and leave comments. If okay, we can merge behind a feature flag.
Maya: Owners & timelines recap: Devon — peering CI + config patch (ETA Fri 18:00 UTC); Priya — on-prem NAT/ACL + metrics (ETA Tue 23:59 UTC); Sam — fallback feature behind FF (ETA next Wed); Irene — SRE approval + smoke test gating (review today).
Charlie: Scheduling: follow-up sync Thu 10:00 PT to verify CA progress and unblock customer comms. Calendar invite sent. :calendar:
Devon: Quick blocker: may need Horizon network team to rotate BGP auth keys for a stable session. I'll ping their contact now.
Horizon-network-bot: Horizon network team notified via email: network-ops@horizon.example — ticket HZN-347 created.
Priya: FYI, on-prem vendor may require a maintenance window for NAT reassign. I'll coordinate on support channel.
Maya: Please post any slips here. If anyone needs assistance with vendor coordination or test harness, call it out.
Devon: Will update INC-8942 with progress tonight.
Sam: Adding synthetic test to CI to catch this pattern going forward.
Irene: After fixes land, let's run a simulated failover exercise with Horizon on a low-traffic window.
Maya: Agreed — plan that for next week after all three patches are merged.
Charlie: I'll follow up after the Thu sync with an issues checklist and assign rotation owners for remediation monitoring.
Maya: Thanks all. Reopen thread if timelines slip or new findings emerge. :thumbsup:
